description: An invariant reading a component attribute whose use-site value reaches server-only code (`API_KEY`, read only by a server function): E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE naming the attribute and the secret (the attribute is a client stand-in under §7.6 (b); the invariant's check would print its value into the client).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-const-read: "a server-only const stays refused"; ruling S483-component-attr-server-only: "an attribute no client code reads gets an empty client stand-in; its default never runs and its use-site value is never evaluated in the client".
